rooms.name: The Entrance to Deadhame
rooms.desc:
You stand at the mouth of a large, man made tunnel.  The smell
of rotting flesh is strong here.  The feeling that you are about
the only one in the area not yet dead comes over you, making chills
run down your spine.  A large sign looks like it should be examined.

extras.desc:
You are at the entrance to Deadhame, an area designed for low 
level characters to explore and conquer.  Most of the monsters here
are well-trained not to attack players unless provoked.  As one 
goes downstairs, he is likely to encounter greater challenges than
he would on the first level, and he might even cross paths with one
of the bad-tempered monsters.  If you are 1-3rd level, you would be
well advised to adventure here as part of a group, or you will find
yourself overwhelmed.  If you are well over 8th level, you may find
the challenges here to be fading, and it is likely time for you to
move on to bigger things.

rooms.name: A hallway
rooms.desc:
You stand in a hallway which runs from East to West.  It is well
lighted, so vision is no problem here.  The Walls are hewn out of the
rocky earth about, and the ceiling is supported by sturdy wooden 
timbers.  The odor here is not too pleasant.

rooms.name: A hallway
rooms.desc:
The hallway forks a bit here.  You have the options of heading
east, west, or south.  The hallway to the south looks as though it is
a little newer than the east-west passage.

rooms.name: A hallway
rooms.desc:
The hallway splits off in four directions here.  As before, the
main passage continues east and west.  To the north is a musty looking
side passage, and to the south is a hallway much like this one, but a 
little newer.

rooms.name: A hallway
rooms.desc:
You stand in a smelly and dirty tunnel hewn out of the rocky soil.
The passage runs east and west, and you think you can see the end of 
the hall not too far to the east.

rooms.name: Atop the staircase
rooms.desc:
This is the eastern end of a well lighted hallway, and the top of 
a roughly fashioned staircase.  A passage to the north is dark and
forboding, and likely full of creepy dead things.  The bottom of the 
stairs appears to be as light as it is up here.

rooms.name: A dark hallway
rooms.desc:
You are standing at the western end of a dark and foul-smelling
hallway.  The support beams don't inspire quite as much confidence as
you might like, but they look strong enough to last for now.  You can
see light to the south.

rooms.name: A dark hallway
rooms.desc:
You stand in a dark passage that is man-made or troll-made or 
something, but it is not natural in any way.  There are doors to the
north and south, made of some strange wood and stained by blood and
gore.  The hallway here runs both east and west.

rooms.name: A dark hallway
rooms.desc:
You stand in a dark passage that is man-made or troll-made or
something, but it is not natural in any way.  There are doors to the
north and south, made of some strange wood and stained by blood and
gore.  The hallway here runs both east and west.

rooms.name: End of a dark hallway
rooms.desc:
You stand at the eastern end of a dark hallway.  A door, however,
is mounted in the middle of the eastern wall.  Other than trying the 
door, your only option seems to be to return to the west, back down the
dark hallway.

rooms.name: A back room
rooms.desc:
This room is apparently the end of the line.  Dirt crumbles omin-
ously from around the support timbers in the northeast corner.  A few
bones and and pieces of dried flesh are strewn about the floor, and the
smell makes you retch.

extras.desc: As you bend down to get a closer look, you see a trapdoor in the floor!

rooms.name: A hallway
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a small side passage that appears to have been
excavated not too long ago.  A chamber to the east is lighted in a red-
ish hue.

rooms.name: A slanted hallway
rooms.desc:
The passage here begins to develop a slope down to the north and
up to the south.  A small room lies to the east, and from here you can
see that it is littered with dismembered body parts.

rooms.name: The Armory
rooms.desc:
This room is strewn with limbs from people who are presumably dead
by now.  The most common parts seem to be arms, and a few of these are
even in decent shape.  The only exit is a small doorway to the west.

rooms.name: The dressing room
rooms.desc:
You are in a small room lit by red candles set into wall sconces.
Several articles of built in furniture here include an antique spin-
ning wheel and a serviceable loom.  Scraps of hair and flesh have been
allowed to clutter the floor.

rooms.name: A slanted hallway
rooms.desc:
You are in a hall that runs from higher ground in the south to
greater depths in the north.  The tunneling here seems to be very 
recent, and the support timbers are freshly cut wood.  A foul stench
permeates the air.

rooms.name: A dead end
rooms.desc:
The hallway comes to an abrupt end here.  The northern wall is 
much rougher than the others, and appears to be the site of current
expansion of the warrens.  You wonder why anyone would need to expand
a home that houses no fertile, living people, but it wasn't your
decision to make.

rooms.name: In the South Annex
rooms.desc:
This area of the Deadhame appears to have been added after the 
original construction was completed.  The quality of the tunnel is 
a little higher than to the north.  The ground, however is rough and
looks like it would really hurt to walk with no shoes.

rooms.name: In the South Annex
rooms.desc:
This area of the Deadhame appears to have been added after the 
original construction was completed.  The quality of the tunnel is 
a little higher than to the north.  The ground, however is rough and
looks like it would really hurt to walk with no shoes.

rooms.name: In the South Annex
rooms.desc:
This area of the Deadhame appears to have been added after the 
original construction was completed.  The quality of the tunnel is 
a little higher than to the north.  The ground, however is rough and
looks like it would really hurt to walk with no shoes.

rooms.name: In the South Annex
rooms.desc:
This area of the Deadhame appears to have been added after the 
original construction was completed.  The quality of the tunnel is 
a little higher than to the north.  The ground, however is rough and
looks like it would really hurt to walk with no shoes.

rooms.name: The shoe shop
rooms.desc:
The walls of this room are hung with various implements that 
would be used by a cobbler.  You note, however, a pointed lack of
nails or quality leathers.  The floor is sprinkled here and there
with bits of thread and rotting flesh.

rooms.name: The barracks
rooms.desc:
This is the room designed to hold the sleeping soldiery of 
Deadhame.  It seems as though corpses shouldn't need much rest, but
nevertheless you stand in their bedroom as it were.

rooms.name: The card room
rooms.desc:
The room is apparently the site of some card games, as posters
on the wall explain the rules to various games of chance, and a 
simple card table stands in the center of the chamber.

extras.desc:
The following are the possible hands and their value, listed
from weakest to strongest:
     Bloodiest card
     Pair of corpses
     Two pair of corpses
     Three corpses
     Death Row
     Bloodbath
     SlaughterHouse
     Four corpses
     Total Regicide

rooms.name: The barracks
rooms.desc:
This is the room designed to hold the sleeping soldiery of 
Deadhame.  It seems as though corpses shouldn't need much rest, but
nevertheless you stand in their bedroom as it were.

rooms.name: The shower room
rooms.desc:
You have entered a small room with a group of nozzles on one wall,
and a bunch of flesh plastered to the opposite wall.

rooms.name: The white room
rooms.desc:
You walk into a room that almost glows in its brightness.  All of the
walls are pure white, and the floor is so white it would make your mother
embarrased about her laundry.

rooms.name: Outside the party
rooms.desc:
A strong smell of liquor eminates from somewhere nearby,  and you
hear a constant thump from some strange party music.

rooms.name: The Zombie Jamboree
rooms.desc:
You are overcome by an extremely strong scent, from which you are
able to pick out the odors of beer, tequilla, and puke.  Several piles
of all three are swimming around your feet.  You think you might 
recognize some sort of organ in it.

rooms.name: The smoke filled room
rooms.desc:
Strange wisps of vapors slowly wind around your body, and seem to 
grip at your weapons and tug at your clothes.

rooms.name: A romantic room
rooms.desc:
You have a sudden romantic urge to neck with someone, anyone, now
if you could just find someone...

24760.name: A confused skeleton
24760.long: A human skeleton stands here, unaware that it has died already.
24760.desc: It looks like bones with the people scraped off.

24761.name: The zombie
24761.long: A zombie stands here, rotting very slowly.
24761.desc:
This poor creature is no more than an animated corpse trying to decay
as nature intended.

24762.name: The dead chimney sweep
24762.long: A well burnt corpse walks about, tidying up.
24762.desc:
It appears to have been caught cleaning a chimney that was not quite 
inactive when it entered.

24763.name: The dead PC
24763.long: A dead PC wonders when you will be dead like him-- probably not long.
24763.desc:
He appears to have lost all of his equipment when he died, and just 
given up mudding as a PC.  Dead characters have less to lose, you know.

24764.name: The barefoot corpse
24764.long: A barefoot corpse stands here, wishing for some new shoes.
24764.desc:
The zombie stamps its feet in an attempt to keep them warm, but its
circulation seems to be rather poor.

24765.name: The Arm-orer
24765.long: A dead man is here, inspecting the arms in his charge.
24765.desc: He seems to be well armed.

24766.name: The Dressmaker
24766.long: An undead Dressmaker is here, putting the finishing touches on a new dress.
24766.desc:
Like most dead people you have seen, the dressmaker before you is rather
unattractive, and is lacking in social graces.

sounds.near: The Dressmaker sews a few stitches.

24767.name: A skeletal mining worker
24767.long: A skeletal miner is here, doing a little tunneling.
24767.desc: He never seems to break a sweat.

sounds.near: The miner manages to clear a little dirt.
sounds.far: You hear a picking and scraping sound.

24768.name: The undead shoemaker
24768.long: A shoemaker is here, trying to sew rotting flesh into a pair of boots.
24768.desc: Bits of his skin are peeling off, but he quickly makes use of it.

sounds.near: The undead shoemaker examines his handiwork and smiles to himself.

24769.name: The zombie
24769.long: A zombie is sleeping here, presumably dying wore him out.
24769.desc: He looks awfully tired... you better not wake the poor thing.

sounds.near: The zombie makes a low noise, not unlike a snore.
sounds.far: You hear a loud snoring sound.

24770.name: The gaming corpse
24770.long: A corpse is here playing cards.

24771.name: The zombie
24771.long: A zombie is here, slowly melting down the drain.
24771.desc: Its flesh is peeling off at an alarming rate.

24772.name: A well-bleached skeleton
24772.long: A well-bleached skeleton stands here, admiring its marble complexion.
24772.desc: About 206 bones, all of them white as ivory.

24773.name: A zombie
24773.long: A zombie stands here, trying to get away from the crowded Jamboree.

24774.name: A partying zombie
24774.long: A zombie is here, enjoying the Zombie Jamboree.
24774.desc:
Packed back to back and belly to belly, it doesn't mind cause its 
dead already.  Its at the Zombie Jamboree!

sounds.near: The zombies dance in close formation.

24775.name: A cloud of smoke
24775.long: Smoke drifts hazily about the room.
24775.desc: It looks a little unclear on the subject.

24776.name: The Headless Vampire
24776.long:
A man without a head tries to lick blood off of his fingers, but he has
no mouth.  Other than the missing head, this guy looks a lot like Bela
Lugosi.
24776.desc: He looks like he hasn't been getting enough to eat and drink recently.

24782.name: A pair of boots
24782.long: A pair of boots is standing here.
24782.desc: This pair appears to have seen a lot of use.

sounds.near: The boots stomp around the room.

24785.name: The Dealer
24785.long: A corpse is here, dealing cards to its friends.
24785.desc: He has a few spare cards tucked away in his clothing.

sounds.near: The Dealer shuffles the cards and deals out a few of them.

24786.name: A dead voter
24786.long: A dead voter is here, voting.
24786.desc: He is wearing a pin with the letters LBJ on it.

24760.name: some rotted flesh
24760.long: A pile of rotted flesh sits here unappetizingly.

24762.name: a disembodied arm
24762.long: A human arm lies unattached on the floor.

24763.name: a pillow
24763.long: A nice, fluffy pillow with stains has been dropped here.

24764.name: a pair of smelly mittens
24764.long: A pair of knitted mittens is on the floor stinking up the room.

24765.name: a dress woven of human hair
24765.long: A tangled mess of hair sits here in a heap.

24766.name: a mining pick
24766.long: A mining pick has been leaned up against the wall.

24767.name: a bottle of bleach
24767.long: A half empty bottle marked "clorox" is tipped on its side in the corner.

24768.name: a cup of ju-juice
24768.long: A small plastic cup of a bubblingv red liquid has sits here unclaimed.

24769.name: a party hat
24769.long: A colorful pointed cardboard hat has been tossed away here.

24770.name: a small vial of blood
24770.long: A small vial here is full of a thick, red liquid

24773.name: a pair of smelly socks
24773.long: A pair of socks lies on the floor-- it has a powerful odor!
